initial_message: I honestly can't believe this. On Tuesday night (the 22nd) water started coming through my kitchen ceiling from a pipe upstairs!! I turned everything off at the main, the plumber came Wednesday morning and fixed the pipe, but the ceiling is wrecked and the floor by the pantry is lifting. I'm so stressed. What do I even do now?
